about.title: Meet Nails by Xaar 🎨
about.description: Hey! I am Xaartje, 19 years old and a nail stylist in Blankenberge (8370). I work both from home and at clients' locations while studying for my nail diploma. I love experimenting with creative nail art and constantly expanding my collection of colors, using only high-quality products.

reviews.subheading: As a beginner nail stylist, I'm dedicated to improving my skills and creating beautiful designs. Check out what my early clients have to say about their experience!
highlights: Trusted by Many for Quality & Creativity

clients.name: Lars De Smet
clients.review: I had a lovely experience! She took her time with my nails and made sure I was happy with the result. Definitely coming back!

clients.name: Sophie Van den Broeck
clients.review: Super friendly and patient! My nails look amazing, and I love the design. Can’t wait for my next appointment!

clients.name: Emma Claes
clients.review: Tried her nail service for the first time, and I was really impressed. She’s still learning, but the effort and care she puts in is great!
